captions.detailed: A pair of tactical night-vision binoculars with a matte black finish. It features two large cylindrical objective barrels with green-tinted lenses and a central structural bridge. At the rear, a rectangular folding eyeshield hood is attached via a revolute hinge, while an auxiliary IR illuminator lens cap is mounted on a front revolute hinge above the main barrels.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of night-vision binoculars using CadQuery. The model should include two cylindrical objective barrels, a central mounting bridge, a folding eyeshield hood at the rear, and an IR illuminator lens cap on the front. Define revolute joints for both the rear eyeshield hood and the front IR illuminator cap to allow them to flip open.
captions.factory: Construct the main chassis by combining two cylinders for the optical barrels and a central box for the bridge. Add green cylindrical lenses to the front. Create the rear folding eyeshield hood using a combination of thin boxes, and define a revolute joint connecting it to the main chassis. Model the IR illuminator cap as a small cylinder and mount it to the front of the bridge using another revolute joint.
